clue.text: Bearing with engagements brings tranquillity

parts.note: a compass bearing such as south-east, abbreviated SE
dates are social engagements or appointments

explanation.surface: Someone's dignified bearing at appointments calms everyone around them.
explanation.definitionFit: To sedate someone is to calm them, giving them a sense of peace.

clue.text: Vegetables stell — that's what Jack found

parts.note: beans are vegetables
to tell is to talk, speak or relate

explanation.surface: Telling about vegetables, the clue points to the fairy tale of Jack.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'stell' is a scanning slip for 'tell'. In the fairy tale Jack and the Beanstalk, Jack trades a cow for magic beans and climbs the giant plant they grow.
explanation.definitionFit: In the fairy tale, Jack's magic beans grow into a giant plant he climbs to the giant's castle.

clue.text: Do battle for commission

definitions.meaning: to fight an enemy, to meet in combat
to hire or take on someone for a job

explanation.definitionFit: Armies engage the enemy when fighting; one engages a builder when hiring them for work.

clue.text: Illness can take a bad turn in a restless person

indicators.note: one thing that can take another holds it within, so the illness word is a container here

parts.note: gout is a painful illness of the joints

indicators.note: taking a bad turn suggests these letters are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A patient's illness may suddenly get worse in someone who cannot keep still.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take a bad turn' reads as worsening, but 'turn' rearranges A BAD to ADAB, which 'can take' puts inside GOUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A gadabout is a pleasure-seeker always on the move, never settling in one place.

clue.text: Got in and arranged a confession

definitions.meaning: entered a place, was allowed inside
obtained or secured an admission of guilt from someone

explanation.definitionFit: Being let in is being granted entry; read literally, the phrase also means securing an admission of guilt, as a detective might.

clue.text: Very sadly, slim lady will not stay that way

indicators.note: letters that refuse to stay in the order given must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A dieter laments that her slim figure will not last.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismally means gloomily, in a sorrowful and dreary manner.

clue.text: A dashing fellow ordered about fifty

indicators.note: the word for ordered goes around the letter for fifty

parts.note: bade is the past tense of bid, to order
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A dashing man barked out orders to some fifty people.
explanation.definitionFit: A blade is an old word for a lively, stylish young man about town.

clue.text: Set out in a French church without any ceremony

parts.note: un is the French for a

indicators.note: set the word out inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone sets out within a French church without any formal rites.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set out in' tells you to place OUT inside CH; UN, French for 'a', goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncouth means rough-mannered, lacking refinement or polite formality.

clue.text: The female's content about nothing on this

indicators.note: the hen's content is what it holds, so other letters go inside it

parts.note: a hen is a female bird
re is Latin-derived for about, concerning
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A woman is happy about having nothing on this.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like happy, but it is the container's contents: RE and O go inside HEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereon is a formal word meaning upon this matter or after this point.

clue.text: An example of the generally accepted viewpoint

parts.note: in means fashionable, accepted by most people
a stance is a position or attitude on an issue

explanation.surface: Someone cites a case illustrating the popular opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is a single case or illustration of something.

clue.text: State support

definitions.meaning: to keep up or provide for

explanation.definitionFit: One maintains an argument by asserting it, and maintains a family by providing for them.

clue.text: The way to arrange a rendezvous

parts.note: a venue is a meeting place, a rendezvous

explanation.surface: Someone explains how to set up a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a road or route, and figuratively a means of approach.

clue.text: He daren't upset the old farm-worker

indicators.note: the letters are knocked over and set down in a new order

explanation.surface: A man is afraid to upset the elderly labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: A neatherd was a cowherd, one who looked after cattle, an archaic job.

clue.text: Totally in the dark?

parts.note: all means wholly, entirely
night is the time of darkness

explanation.surface: Someone is completely ignorant of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the dark' looks like ignorance, but read literally the whole clue describes something lasting through the entire night.
explanation.definitionFit: An event lasting till dawn spans every hour of darkness.

clue.text: Only really well when in employment?

definitions.text: Only really well when in employment?

parts.words: Only really well when in employment?
parts.note: describes someone sick whenever idle, read with 'at ease' as off duty, not working

explanation.definitionFit: Feeling uncomfortable is the idiom; the clue reads it as being sick whenever resting.

clue.text: Some hick possibly longing for his own place

indicators.note: a possible version of the words is another arrangement of their letters

explanation.surface: A country bumpkin perhaps pines for his rural home.
explanation.definitionFit: Being homesick is yearning for one's home while away from it.

clue.text: An area of interest to developers

definitions.text: An area of interest to developers

parts.words: An area of interest to developers
parts.note: reads like property developers eyeing land, but means photographers who develop film

explanation.definitionFit: Photographic film is processed in a room kept free of light.

clue.text: A note about the principal goddess

indicators.note: the first pieces go around the word for principal

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
the star is the principal performer

explanation.surface: A musical note concerns the leading performer.
explanation.walkthrough: Astarte was the ancient Phoenician goddess of fertility and love.
explanation.definitionFit: Astarte was a Semitic deity of love and war, worshipped in the ancient Near East.

clue.text: Charging at one time, not being on the level

definitions.meaning: jousting, as knights once charged at each other with lances

explanation.definitionFit: Knights tilted in jousts; a sloping surface tilts away from the horizontal.

clue.text: Awfully daring, if hardly decorous

indicators.note: done awfully, the letters come out badly arranged

explanation.surface: Something very bold is barely respectable.
explanation.walkthrough: Infra dig, from Latin infra dignitatem, means beneath one's dignity.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beneath one's dignity is unseemly or improper.

clue.text: Afters could be served -more quickly!

indicators.note: served up differently, the letters are dished out in a new order

explanation.surface: A diner urges that pudding be brought sooner.
explanation.walkthrough: Afters is British slang for dessert, the course served after the main meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Faster is the comparative of fast, meaning with greater speed.

clue.text: Took steps in order to exterminate most rodents

indicators.note: the letters wanted are tucked inside the words, the outer ones killed off

explanation.surface: Someone acted to wipe out nearly all the rats and mice.
explanation.definitionFit: Strode is the past tense of stride, to walk with long paces.

clue.text: To hold out is simply not on with Her Majesty

parts.note: off is the opposite of on
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: Resisting the Queen is simply out of the question.
explanation.definitionFit: To offer is to extend or present something, as a hand held out.

clue.text: Distrusts American coppers going into schools

indicators.note: the first pieces go inside the word for schools

parts.note: schools of thought are sects
US stands for the United States, American
copper coins are pence, abbreviated P

explanation.surface: US police officers enter schools and are viewed with mistrust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police, but means copper coins, giving P for pence.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspect someone is to doubt them or believe them guilty.

clue.text: Writing on the wall, having fair gift maybe for it/

indicators.note: maybe suggests a possible rearrangement of the given letters

explanation.surface: A message on the wall seems to be a lovely present.
explanation.definitionFit: Graffiti are words or drawings scrawled on public walls.

clue.text: Relaxing and say embracing when at home

indicators.note: the outer letters hug the others inside them

parts.note: EG, for example, is signalled by say
as means while or when
in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone unwinds as they say they are home.
explanation.definitionFit: Easing means loosening or lessening tension, letting up.

clue.text: Head-dress making supports family

parts.note: bears means carries or holds up
kin are relatives, family

explanation.surface: A hat is what keeps relatives going.
explanation.walkthrough: A bearskin is the tall black fur cap worn by British Guards regiments outside Buckingham Palace.
explanation.definitionFit: Guards wear this tall fur cap as ceremonial headgear.
